affected_areas.area: Authentication account contract and /login JSON behavior
affected_areas.evidence: app.py removes automation_user2 and error_user from the mock users store. tests/api/test_login_api.py updates valid coverage to guest_user and automation_user1, and rejected coverage to invalid_user, automation_user2, and error_user.

affected_areas.area: Browser login workflow and accessible authentication feedback
affected_areas.evidence: templates/login.html retains the login form and accessible error/status regions while adding the documented invalid_user example. tests/ui/test_login_ui.py changes the invalid-login scenario to submit invalid_user with the demo password.

templates/login.html adds a Demo credentials section, four buttons with explicit aria-label values, and visible expected-failure text for invalid_user. tests/test_routes.py asserts these labels, content, button count, script reference, and absence of removed usernames.

affected_areas.area: Clipboard copy interaction and transient UI feedback
affected_areas.evidence: static/js/login.js implements Clipboard API use, an execCommand fallback, success/failure feedback, and a 1600 ms reset. templates/login.html loads this script and supplies data-copy-value controls.

static/css/styles.css introduces a two-column login-workspace layout and a max-width 767.98px media query that switches it to one column; it also adds styling for credential groups, controls, copied state, and negative-test emphasis.

affected_areas.area: Published test-plan and UI-test reporting metadata
affected_areas.evidence: static/js/test_plan.js revises 01.01, 01.02, and 03.03 for the new credentials and adds 03.08. tests/test_normalize_test_results.py and tests/test_routes.py update expected UI IDs and totals through 03.08.

analysis_limitations: Only changed-file patches were supplied; the complete app.py /login implementation, complete templates, and unchanged test bodies were not available for inspection.
The QA catalog identifies test names and metadata but does not provide execution results; no conclusion about test pass/fail status is made.

No browser/device matrix, viewport configuration, or accessibility-tool output was supplied, so cross-browser, mobile rendering, and assistive-technology behavior cannot be determined from the evidence.
analysis.change_summary: The Login Demo reduces accepted authentication accounts to guest_user and automation_user1, while automation_user2 and error_user are removed and invalid_user is presented as the documented negative example. The /login page is redesigned into a responsive credential helper alongside the login form, adds four accessible clipboard-copy controls with temporary feedback, and loads new login.js behavior. API, route, UI, test-plan, and test-result normalization coverage were updated to reflect the revised account contract and new UI scenario.

coverage_gaps.area: Copy values for automation_user1 and invalid_user
coverage_gaps.reason: The supplied 03.08 implementation locates and checks visibility/enabled state for these controls but only clicks and reads the clipboard for guest_user and secret_pass123.

coverage_gaps.area: Clipboard fallback and failure feedback paths
coverage_gaps.reason: login.js includes a Clipboard API denial fallback using document.execCommand and a Try again state, but the supplied tests do not evidence either branch.

CSS adds distinct desktop grid and mobile single-column behavior, but no supplied catalog test explicitly verifies the layout at a mobile viewport or checks that both form and credential controls remain usable there.

qa_notes: The API test changes provide direct regression coverage for both the newly supported account set and removed account rejection.
The route assertions check static rendered markup and script inclusion; the Playwright test provides the evidence for actual clipboard behavior.

The test-plan entry 03.08 describes locating all four controls and checking the negative example, while its supplied UI implementation additionally verifies clipboard contents only for guest_user and the password.

analysis.risk_rationale: This changes the authentication allowlist, so previously accepted demo credentials now return an invalid-credentials response. It also adds browser-side clipboard behavior and restructures the login page markup and responsive layout. The supplied catalog includes targeted API, route, and Playwright coverage for the main changed behavior, which moderates risk, but some copy-control branches and responsive presentation are not evidenced as exercised.
